{
  "dataset_name": "phoneme",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "distance_to_global_centroid",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance to the global unsupervised centroid of all features, normalized by their standard deviations.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 20.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a standardized distance metric to the center of the data distribution, helping KNN identify outliers and central points.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((V1 - 0.838)/0.882)**2 + ((V2 - 1.273)/0.876)**2 + ((V3 - 0.727)/0.925)**2 + ((V4 - 0.391)/0.783)**2 + ((V5 - 0.097)/0.588)**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "distance_to_origin",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance to the origin in the original feature space.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the overall energy or magnitude of the phoneme signal, which is a useful geometric property for distance-based models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(V1**2 + V2**2 + V3**2 + V4**2 + V5**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_euclidean_distance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute difference between the first two features, representing the distance in the lower frequency bands.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "feature_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights local geometric relationships between adjacent frequency bands, improving neighborhood similarity calculations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt((V1 - V2)**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v3_v4_v5_magnitude",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Magnitude of the higher frequency features (V3, V4, V5).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Isolates the energy in higher frequency bands, allowing KNN to group samples with similar high-frequency characteristics.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(V3**2 + V4**2 + V5**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "spectral_centroid_proxy",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "A weighted average of the features, acting as a proxy for the spectral centroid.",
      "value_range": [-5.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "spectral_shape",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Summarizes the shape of the spectrum into a single continuous value, providing a strong similarity metric for KNN.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V1 + 2*V2 + 3*V3 + 4*V4 + 5*V5) / (np.abs(V1) + np.abs(V2) + np.abs(V3) + np.abs(V4) + np.abs(V5) + 0.001)"
    },
    {
      "name": "max_amplitude",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The maximum value across all five features.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "extreme_value",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Identifies the peak energy across the spectrum, useful for aligning similar signal profiles in distance calculations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(V1, V2), V3), V4), V5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "min_amplitude",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The minimum value across all five features.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "extreme_value",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the lowest energy point in the spectrum, adding another dimension for geometric comparison.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(V1, V2), V3), V4), V5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "amplitude_range",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The difference between the maximum and minimum feature values.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "dispersion",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Measures the dynamic range of the features, helping to distinguish between flat and highly variable spectra.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(V1, V2), V3), V4), V5) - np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(V1, V2), V3), V4), V5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "low_to_high_energy_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of energy in the lower features (V1, V2) to the higher features (V4, V5).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1000.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a scale-invariant measure of spectral balance, which is highly effective for grouping similar sounds in KNN.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V1**2 + V2**2) / (V4**2 + V5**2 + 0.001)"
    },

      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment of whether the feature profile resembles a vowel sound, characterized by dominant low-frequency energy.",
